title: XI. Of the Juſtification of man.

segments.text: VVE are accounted rightous before God, only for the Merit of our Lord and Saviour Jeſus Chriſt by Faith, and not for our own works, or deſervings. Wherefore, that we are juſtified by Faith only, is a moſt wholſom Doctrine, and very full of comfort, as more largely is expreſſed in the Homily of Juſtification.
